comment.cs: Vláda odmítla ETS2 usnesením (16. 12. 2025) a prosazuje jeho odklad. comment.en: The government rejected ETS2 by resolution (16 Dec 2025) and advocates its postponement. It approved Act No. 63/2026 Coll. on fuel price regulation (published 13 May 2026) and resumed regulation from 1 Oct 2026. However, ETS2 was definitively approved by the EU on 9 Oct 2026 and will enter into force in 2028 – the government thus failed to fulfil the promise, only declaring opposition. The 10% electricity reduction was announced but without legislative anchoring.

comment.en: The government declares support for diplomatic resolution and confirms the role of other actors. Czechia participates in discussions about peace plans and supports Ukraine. Babiš deklaruje, že Česko podporuje Ukrajinu, ale odmítá ručit za půjčky; tím se připojuje k Orbánově a Ficovu linii, která oslabuje jednotnost EU.
comment.en: The government violated its pledge to defend unanimity and shared positions. Instead of leading a unified EU approach, Czechia backed away from guarantees for Ukraine (along with Hungary and Slovakia) and blocks further support. Babiš declares that Czechia supports Ukraine but refuses to guarantee loans; thus joining Orbán and Fico's line, which weakens EU unity.
